results.question: how do i change the amount of buggies we have available
results.expected: Route to buggy capacity/system configuration rather than service setup.
results.notes: Correctly answers with System Configuration and buggy availability settings; actionable enough for staff.
results.reply:
Check Buggy Booking Availability

1. Use the main navigation menu to open "Tools".
2. On the "Tools" page, open "System Configuration" in the Basic Set Up Requirements section.
3. Use the Buggy Booking settings in "System Configuration".
4. Check the number of buggies available, how long each buggy is needed before and after a round, whether visitors are allowed to book buggies online, and whether the club expects the buggy price to be added by staff after booking.
5. Click Update on "System Configuration", then check the "Timesheet" to confirm buggy availability is appearing as expected.
